description: Flat metadata schema for individual patient records in a breast cancer radiotherapy clinical registry, including demographics, tumor and genetic characteristics, prior treatments, radiotherapy plan, treatment sessions, protocol deviations, acute toxicity, and follow-up outcomes.

patient_id.descr: Unique registry identifier for the individual patient record; should be stable and non-identifying if possible.

patient_age_at_diagnosis_years.descr: Age of the patient at breast cancer diagnosis, in years.

patient_sex.descr: Biological sex of the patient; typical values include female, male, intersex, or unknown.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or registry-coded race/ethnicity category used for subgroup analyses.

body_mass_index_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index at baseline, in kg/m^2.

menopausal_status.descr: Menopausal status at diagnosis or treatment start; typical values include premenopausal, perimenopausal, postmenopausal, or unknown.

family_history_breast_cancer.descr: Whether the patient has a documented family history of breast cancer.

genetic_marker_name.descr: Name of the genetic marker, variant, or biomarker assessed (for example, BRCA1, BRCA2, HER2, PIK3CA).

genetic_marker_result.descr: Result or status of the genetic marker; typical values include positive, negative, variant_of_uncertain_significance, amplified, overexpressed, or unknown.

tumor_laterality.descr: Side of the breast cancer; typical values include left, right, bilateral, or unknown.

tumor_histology.descr: Histologic subtype of the breast tumor, such as invasive ductal carcinoma, invasive lobular carcinoma, or ductal carcinoma in situ.

tumor_grade.descr: Tumor histologic grade, usually an ordinal category such as 1, 2, 3, or unknown.

clinical_stage.descr: Clinical stage at diagnosis, ideally using TNM-derived or AJCC stage group notation.

tumor_receptor_status.descr: Primary receptor phenotype summary, such as ER/PR/HER2 positive or negative; use controlled clinical terminology where available.

prior_surgery_type.descr: Type of breast cancer surgery performed before radiotherapy, if any; examples include lumpectomy, mastectomy, sentinel node biopsy, or none.

prior_chemotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received chemotherapy before radiotherapy.

prior_hormone_therapy.descr: Whether the patient received endocrine or hormone therapy before radiotherapy.

prior_immunotherapy.descr: Whether the patient received immunotherapy before radiotherapy.

prior_targeted_therapy.descr: Whether the patient received targeted therapy before radiotherapy.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Clinical intent of radiotherapy; examples include adjuvant, neoadjuvant, definitive, palliative, or salvage.

radiotherapy_site.descr: Anatomic treatment site or field, such as whole breast, chest wall, regional nodes, or boost volume.

radiation_type.descr: Type of radiation modality used; examples include photon, electron, proton, mixed modality, or unknown.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Delivery technique used, such as 3D conformal, IMRT, VMAT, tangential fields, or other specified technique.

planned_total_dose_gy.descr: Planned total prescribed radiation dose, in Gray (Gy).

planned_dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Planned dose per fraction, in Gray (Gy).

planned_treatment_duration_days.descr: Planned overall treatment duration from first to last fraction, in days.

treatment_completion_status.descr: Whether the prescribed radiotherapy course was completed as planned; typical values include completed, interrupted, discontinued, or unknown.

session_number.descr: Ordinal number of the radiotherapy session/fraction within the course.

delivered_dose_gy.descr: Dose actually delivered during the session, in Gray (Gy).

session_duration_minutes.descr: Duration of the treatment session, in minutes.

protocol_deviation_occurred.descr: Whether any deviation from the planned protocol occurred during this session.

protocol_deviation_type.descr: Type of protocol deviation, such as dose omission, dose reduction, delay, setup issue, field modification, or machine interruption.

protocol_deviation_description.descr: Free-text description of the protocol deviation when details are needed beyond the coded category.

acute_side_effect_present.descr: Whether an acute side effect or toxicity was observed during or shortly after the session/course.

acute_side_effect_type.descr: Primary acute toxicity type, such as dermatitis, fatigue, pain, edema, mucositis, nausea, or pneumonitis.

acute_side_effect_grade.descr: Severity grade of the acute side effect, preferably using CTCAE grade 0 to 5.

acute_side_effect_onset_date.descr: Date when the acute side effect first appeared.

acute_side_effect_resolution_date.descr: Date when the acute side effect resolved, if known.

follow_up_duration_months.descr: Time from radiotherapy completion or diagnosis to last follow-up, in months.

disease_recurrence_occurred.descr: Whether disease recurrence was documented during follow-up.

disease_recurrence_date.descr: Date of first documented disease recurrence, if applicable.

recurrence_site.descr: Anatomic site of recurrence, such as local, regional, distant, bone, lung, liver, or brain.

patient_recovery_status.descr: Overall recovery status at follow-up; examples include recovered, partially_recovered, not_recovered, deceased, or unknown.

overall_survival_status.descr: Vital status at last follow-up; typical values include alive, deceased, or unknown.

last_follow_up_date.descr: Date of the last known clinical follow-up.

cause_of_death.descr: Documented cause of death, if known; use cancer-related, treatment-related, other, or free text as needed.
